services.name: Private CHARTERS
services.desc: Experience the water like never before with a private captained cruise with Seager Marine manning the helm. The perfect way to relax and create unforgettable memories without any of the hassles. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion, hosting friends and family, or want to experience wake Surfing on Canandaigua Lake , Our Trained and certified captains will handle every detail so you can focus on fun. Enjoy a day trip cruising on our luxury Catalina , try all the water sports on our Nautique G25, or Have a blast out on our signature Double Decker with waterslide to enjoy your own personal on the water playground. services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Whether you're a local looking for something fun to do with your family, or a visitor searching for the best activities in the area, our on-the-water experiences will have you making memories in no time. Enjoy a full-day boat rental-or better yet, an entire week-out on the water in one of our pontoons or powerboats. Before you head out, our team will provide a thorough boating safety overview and help guide you with recommendations on sights to see and the best places to explore, ensuring you have an unforgettable experience. Looking to add a little more excitement? Enhance your day with add-ons like wakeboards, tubes, water skis, and I-float mats for even more fun on the water. Boat

services.name: Kayak & SUP Rentals
services.desc: Get out on the water at your own pace with Seager Marine’s stand-up paddleboards (SUPs) and kayaks - the perfect way to explore the shoreline, enjoy a peaceful morning paddle, or add variety to your day on the lake. Whether you’re seeking a low-impact workout, scenic adventure, or relaxed cruising around coves and bays, our SUPs and kayaks are easy to use for all skill levels. Rentals include quality equipment and safety gear to help you make the most of your time on the water with confidence and comfort.
